headline: As of 2026-10-16: 7,570,713 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 39 of 50 states, D+19.9 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 7,570,713 early/mail ballots cast so far across 39 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+19.9 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (859,782), Florida (786,536), Virginia (635,346).
